# Forage India

> A free guide to wild food in India: which wild plants are in season in each state and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 124 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Moringa](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/moringa/): Moringa oleifera; Sahjan, Nugge, Murungai, Shevga. In season all year round.
- [Amaranth](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/amaranth/): Amaranthus viridis; Chaulai, Dantu soppu, Keerai, Math. In season June to November.
- [Bathua](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/bathua/): Chenopodium album; Bathua, Chakota soppu, Chakvat. In season November to March.
- [Purslane](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/purslane/): Portulaca oleracea; Kulfa, Goni soppu, Paruppu keerai, Ghol. In season March to September.
- [Wood sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/woodsorrel/): Oxalis corniculata; Amrul, Huli soppu, Puliyarai. In season June to February.
- [Indian pennywort](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/pennywort/): Centella asiatica; Brahmi, Ondelaga, Vallarai, Thankuni. In season June to October.
- [Curry leaves](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/curry/): Murraya koenigii; Kadi patta, Karibevu, Kariveppilai, Kadhi limdo. In season all year round.
- [Colocasia leaves](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/colocasia/): Colocasia esculenta; Arbi patta, Kesu, Alu, Chembu. In season June to September.
- [Stinging nettle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/nettle/): Urtica dioica; Bichhu buti, Kandali, Sisnu. In season February to November.
- [Fiddlehead fern](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/fiddlehead/): Diplazium esculentum; Lingdu, Dhekia, Ningro. In season March to August.
- [Bamboo shoots](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/bamboo/): Bambusa; Bans karil, Kalale, Khorisa, Mesu. In season June to September.
- [Amla](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/amla/): Phyllanthus emblica; Amla, Nellikayi, Nellikai, Avla. In season November to February.
- [Jamun](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/jamun/): Syzygium cumini; Jamun, Nerale, Naaval, Kalojam. In season May to July.
- [Ber](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/ber/): Ziziphus mauritiana; Ber, Elachi hannu, Ilanthai, Bor. In season December to March.
- [Wild mango](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/mango/): Mangifera indica; Aam, Appe midi, Kaadu maavu. In season April to June.
- [Jackfruit](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/jackfruit/): Artocarpus heterophyllus; Kathal, Halasu, Pala, Phanas. In season March to July.
- [Tamarind](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/tamarind/): Tamarindus indica; Imli, Hunase, Puli, Chinch. In season January to April.
- [Bael](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/bael/): Aegle marmelos; Bael, Bilva, Vilvam, Bel. In season March to June.
- [Cluster fig](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/fig/): Ficus racemosa; Gular, Atti, Atthi, Umbar. In season March to August.
- [Karonda](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/karonda/): Carissa carandas; Karonda, Kavali, Kalakkai, Karvand. In season July to September.
- [Kokum](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/kokum/): Garcinia indica; Kokum, Murugalu, Bhirand. In season March to May.
- [Cashew apple & nut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/cashew/): Anacardium occidentale; Kaju, Geru, Mundiri, Kaju bondu. In season March to May.
- [Palmyra palm](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/palmyra/): Borassus flabellifer; Tadgola, Taati nungu, Nungu, Taal. In season April to January.
- [Khejri (sangri)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/sangri/): Prosopis cineraria; Sangri, Khejri, Shami. In season March to May.
- [Ker](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/ker/): Capparis decidua; Ker, Kair, Karil. In season April to June.
- [Lasoda](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/lasoda/): Cordia myxa; Lasoda, Gunda, Lasura. In season April to June.
- [Seabuckthorn](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/seabuckthorn/): Hippophae rhamnoides; Tsestalulu, Chharma. In season August to October.
- [Kafal](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/kafal/): Myrica esculenta; Kafal, Kaphal. In season April to June.
- [Hisalu](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/hisalu/): Rubus ellipticus; Hisalu, Ainselu. In season April to June.
- [Walnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/walnut/): Juglans regia; Akhrot, Doon. In season September to October.
- [Chironji](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/chironji/): Buchanania lanzan; Chironji, Charoli, Saara paruppu. In season April to May.
- [Indian almond](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/almond/): Terminalia catappa; Desi badam, Kaadu badaami, Nattuvadumai. In season July to December.
- [Mahua](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/mahua/): Madhuca longifolia; Mahua, Ippe, Iluppai, Moha. In season March to June.
- [Wild yam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/yam/): Dioscorea; Jangli kand, Kaadu genasu, Kaattu kizhangu. In season October to February.
- [Water chestnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/singhara/): Trapa natans; Singhara, Paniphal. In season October to December.
- [Lotus stem & seeds](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/lotus/): Nelumbo nucifera; Kamal kakdi, Nadru, Bhein, Makhana. In season October to February.
- [Wild honey](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/honey/): Apis dorsata; Jangli shahad, Kaadu jenu, Kaattu then. In season March to May.
- [Clams & shellfish](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/shellfish/): Meretrix casta; Marvai, Tisrya, Kakka. In season October to March.
- [Paddy snails & small fish](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/snails/): Pila globosa; Gugli, Shamuk, Nathai. In season July to November.
- [Sessile joyweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/honagonne/): Alternanthera sessilis; Honagonne, Ponnanganni, Matsyakshi. In season all year round.
- [Spiny amaranth](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/spinyamaranth/): Amaranthus spinosus; Kateli chaulai, Mullu harive, Mullu keerai. In season June to October.
- [Malabar spinach](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/basale/): Basella alba; Poi saag, Basale, Pasalai, Mayalu. In season June to November.
- [Water spinach](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/kalmi/): Ipomoea aquatica; Kalmi saag, Nali bhaji, Vallal keerai. In season June to November.
- [Sickle senna](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/chakoda/): Senna tora; Chakoda, Takla, Thagache, Panwar. In season June to August.
- [Spiny gourd](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/kantola/): Momordica dioica; Kantola, Kakroda, Madahagala, Kartoli. In season July to September.
- [Ivy gourd](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/ivygourd/): Coccinia grandis; Kundru, Tondli, Thonde, Kovakkai. In season March to November.
- [Wild banana flower & stem](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/bananaflower/): Musa balbisiana; Kela phool, Bale hoovu, Vazhaipoo, Kol posola. In season all year round.
- [Fishwort](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/fishwort/): Houttuynia cordata; Ja mardoh, Toningkhok, Masundari. In season March to July.
- [Culantro](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/culantro/): Eryngium foetidum; Bilati dhonia, Bhot dhaniya. In season all year round.
- [Tree bean](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/treebean/): Parkia timoriana; Yongchak, Zawngtah, Kharial. In season November to March.
- [Kachnar buds](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/kachnar/): Bauhinia variegata; Kachnar, Kuler, Koliar. In season February to April.
- [Agathi flowers & leaves](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/agathi/): Sesbania grandiflora; Agastya, Agase, Agathi keerai, Bok phool. In season October to February.
- [Buransh](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/buransh/): Rhododendron arboreum; Buransh, Lali gurans. In season February to April.
- [Neem flowers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/neemflower/): Azadirachta indica; Neem, Bevu hoovu, Veppam poo. In season March to April.
- [Phog](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/phog/): Calligonum polygonoides; Phog, Phogla. In season March to April.
- [Kachri](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/kachri/): Cucumis callosus; Kachri, Kachar, Kachariya. In season October to December.
- [Matira](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/matira/): Citrullus lanatus; Matira, Kalinga. In season August to October.
- [Peelu](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/peelu/): Salvadora oleoides; Peelu, Jaal, Mitha jaal. In season May to June.
- [Kumat](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/kumat/): Senegalia senegal; Kumat, Kumtha. In season November to January.
- [Kendu](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/kendu/): Diospyros melanoxylon; Tendu, Kendu, Beedi patta. In season April to June.
- [Kusum](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/kusum/): Schleichera oleosa; Kusum, Kosam, Puvam. In season May to July.
- [Wild date palm](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/wilddate/): Phoenix sylvestris; Khajur, Eechalu, Eechampazham, Shindi. In season May to July.
- [Wild phalsa](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/grewia/): Grewia; Phalsa, Dhaman. In season May to June.
- [Wood apple](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/kaith/): Limonia acidissima; Kaith, Bela, Vilampazham, Kavath. In season October to March.
- [Wild custard apple](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/custardapple/): Annona squamosa; Sitaphal, Seethaphala, Seetha pazham. In season August to November.
- [Feral guava](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/guava/): Psidium guajava; Amrood, Sebe hannu, Koyya, Peru. In season August to December.
- [Monkey jack](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/monkeyjack/): Artocarpus lacucha; Lakuch, Vate huli, Dehua. In season June to August.
- [Malabar tamarind](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/kudampuli/): Garcinia gummi-gutta; Kudampuli, Uppage, Kodampuli. In season June to August.
- [Hog plum](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/hogplum/): Spondias pinnata; Amra, Ambade, Amate, Ambazhanga. In season August to November.
- [Jungle jalebi](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/jalebi/): Pithecellobium dulce; Vilayati imli, Seemai puli, Kodukkapuli, Ganga imli. In season March to May.
- [Elephant apple](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/elephantapple/): Dillenia indica; Ou tenga, Chalta, Uva. In season October to January.
- [Sohiong](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/sohiong/): Prunus napaulensis; Sohiong. In season September to October.
- [Mulberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/mulberry/): Morus alba; Shahtoot, Hippunerale, Tuti. In season March to May.
- [Wild Himalayan pear](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/mehal/): Pyrus pashia; Mehal, Batangi, Kainth. In season October to December.
- [Kilmora](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/kilmora/): Berberis asiatica; Kilmora, Kingor, Chutro. In season May to July.
- [Timla](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/timla/): Ficus auriculata; Timla, Timul, Trembal. In season May to August.
- [Ghain](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/ghain/): Elaeagnus umbellata; Ghain, Kankoli. In season July to August.
- [Wild pomegranate](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/daru/): Punica granatum; Daru, Darim, Daruni. In season September to October.
- [Wild apricot](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/apricot/): Prunus armeniaca; Chulu, Chulli, Zardalu. In season June to July.
- [Chilgoza pine nuts](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/chilgoza/): Pinus gerardiana; Chilgoza, Neoza, Ri. In season September to October.
- [Makhana](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/makhana/): Euryale ferox; Makhana, Fox nut, Gorgon nut. In season August to October.
- [Bamboo rice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/bamboorice/): Bambusa bambos; Mulayari, Bidiru akki, Moongil arisi. In season March to May.
- [Wild elephant foot yam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/suran/): Amorphophallus paeoniifolius; Jangli suran, Suvarna gadde, Chena, Ol. In season November to March.
- [Tikhur](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/tikhur/): Curcuma angustifolia; Tikhur, Jangli aloo, East Indian arrowroot. In season December to February.
- [Red ant chutney](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/redant/): Oecophylla smaragdina; Kai pimpudi, Kai chutney, Chaprah. In season all year round.
- [Paddy crabs](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/crab/): Barytelphusa; Kekda, Chimbori, Nandu, Kakra. In season July to October.
- [Wild taro corms](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/taro/): Colocasia esculenta; Arbi, Kesuvina gadde, Seppankizhangu, Kosu. In season October to February.
- [Wild asparagus shoots](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/shatavari/): Asparagus racemosus; Shatavari, Satmuli, Halavu makkala thayi. In season June to August.
- [Cane shoots](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/cane/): Calamus tenuis; Bet gaaj, Chural. In season July to September.
- [Palm tuber](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/palmtuber/): Borassus flabellifer; Panang kizhangu, Thati gegulu. In season December to January.
- [Vidarikand](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/vidari/): Pueraria tuberosa; Vidarikand, Bilaikand. In season November to February.
- [Jambu (Himalayan wild onion)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/jambu/): Allium stracheyi; Jambu, Jimbu, Faran. In season June to August.
- [Wild rice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/wildrice/): Oryza rufipogon; Nivara, Neevar, Uri dhan, Kattu nellu. In season October to December.
- [Jungle rice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/junglerice/): Echinochloa colona; Sawa, Sanwak, Kuthiraivali (wild). In season September to November.
- [Bhurat](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/bhurat/): Cenchrus biflorus; Bhurat, Bharut. In season September to October.

- [Wild mung](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/wildmung/): Vigna radiata; Jangli moong, Kaadu hesaru. In season October to December.
- [Rice bean](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/ricebean/): Vigna umbellata; Naga dal, Sutri, Naurangi. In season October to December.
- [Velvet bean](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/mucuna/): Mucuna pruriens; Kaunch, Nasagunni, Poonaikkali. In season November to February.
- [Siali seeds](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/plants/siali/): Phanera vahlii; Siali, Mahul, Maljhan. In season March to May.

## Dishes

- [Kokum sharbat](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/kokum-sharbat/): Soak dried kokum rinds overnight, mash and strain. Add jaggery, a pinch of roasted cumin and salt, then top up with cold water.
- [Sol kadhi](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/sol-kadhi/): Soak kokum in warm water, then mix the pink extract with coconut milk, crushed garlic, green chilli and salt. Drink chilled after meals.
- [Aam panna](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/aam-panna/): Boil or roast raw mangoes, scoop out the pulp and blend it with jaggery, roasted cumin, black salt and mint. Dilute with cold water.
- [Amla juice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/amla-juice/): Deseed amla, blend with water, ginger and a little honey or jaggery, then strain. Drink fresh, since vitamin C fades fast.
- [Bael sharbat](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/bael-sharbat/): Crack the shell, soak the pulp in water, mash, and strain out the seeds and fibres. Sweeten with jaggery and add a pinch of black salt.
- [Wood apple sharbat](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/wood-apple-sharbat/): Scoop out the pulp, mash it in water with jaggery, strain, and add roasted cumin.
- [Jamun juice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/jamun-juice/): Deseed ripe jamun, blend with water, lime, black salt and a little sugar. Strain and drink chilled.
- [Phalsa sharbat](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/phalsa-sharbat/): Mash ripe berries in water, strain out the seeds, then add sugar, black salt and roasted cumin.
- [Karonda squash](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/karonda-squash/): Boil ripe karondas, strain, then cook the juice with sugar into a syrup. Dilute 1:4 with water to serve.
- [Buransh squash](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/buransh-squash/): Simmer red buransh petals in water, strain, then cook with sugar and lemon into a squash. Dilute to drink.
- [Seabuckthorn juice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/seabuckthorn-juice/): Crush berries, strain through cloth, and sweeten with honey. Very sour and full of vitamin C.
- [Himalayan berry juice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/himalayan-berry-juice/): Crush ripe wild berries with a little water, strain, then add honey and a pinch of salt.
- [Mulberry sharbat](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/mulberry-sharbat/): Mash ripe mulberries, strain, cook with sugar into a syrup, and dilute with chilled water and lime.
- [Imli sharbat](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/imli-sharbat/): Soak tamarind with jaggery, strain, then add roasted cumin, black salt and dry ginger. Dilute with cold water.
- [Nungu drink](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/nungu-drink/): Peel and chop tender nungu, then mix with its own juice, chilled milk or water, and a little rose syrup or sugar.
- [Neera (fresh palm sap)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/neera/): Collected at dawn from tapped palms and drunk straight away.
- [Cashew apple juice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/cashew-apple-juice/): Squeeze ripe cashew apples, then mix the juice with a little rice kanji or salt to cut the throat-catching astringency.
- [Moringa tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/moringa-tea/): Steep a spoon of dried moringa leaves or powder in hot water for 5 minutes, and add lemon and honey.
- [Neer mor (spiced buttermilk)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/neer-mor/): Whisk curd with water, crushed curry leaves, ginger, green chilli and salt.
- [Ondelaga juice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/ondelaga-juice/): Blend a handful of pennywort leaves with water, jaggery and lime, then strain. Or grind them into buttermilk for tambuli.
- [Tikhur cooler](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/tikhur-cooler/): Stir a spoon of tikhur starch into cold water or milk with sugar. A traditional summer cooler in Chhattisgarh.
- [Sohiong juice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/sohiong-juice/): Crush the purple fruit with water and sugar, and strain.
- [Matira juice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/matira-juice/): Blend the flesh with a pinch of black salt and mint, and drink straight away.
- [Nettle tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/nettle-tea/): Steep fresh (gloved) or dried nettle leaves in hot water for 5–10 minutes.
- [Ambade cooler](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/ambade-cooler/): Boil ripe hog plums, mash, strain, and add jaggery, salt and a little chilli.
- [Agase hoovina bajji](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/agase-hoovina-bajji/): Agathi flowers dipped in spiced besan batter and fried crisp. A Karnataka monsoon snack.
- [Vazhaipoo vadai](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/vazhaipoo-vadai/): Chopped banana flower in a coarse chana dal batter with onion and curry leaves, shallow-fried.
- [Drumstick leaf pakoda](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/drumstick-leaf-pakoda/): Moringa leaves stirred into besan with onion and chilli, fried in small fritters.
- [Alu vadi / patra / pathrode](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/alu-vadi-patra-pathrode/): Colocasia leaves layered with spiced gram or rice batter, rolled, steamed, sliced and tempered.
- [Basale pakoras](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/basale-pakoras/): Whole Malabar spinach leaves dipped in batter and fried.
- [Ilanthai vadai](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/ilanthai-vadai/): Dried ber pounded with jaggery, chilli and salt, then pressed into sweet-sour sun-dried discs. Tamil Nadu's school-gate snack.
- [Jackfruit chips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/jackfruit-chips/): Firm unripe bulbs sliced thin and fried in coconut oil with salt.
- [Roasted jackfruit seeds](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/roasted-jackfruit-seeds/): Seeds roasted in hot sand or a pan, then peeled and salted. Nutty and filling.
- [Panang kizhangu](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/panang-kizhangu/): Palm tubers boiled with turmeric and salt, peeled and eaten warm.
- [Roasted makhana](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/roasted-makhana/): Fox nuts tossed in ghee with salt, pepper and chaat masala until crunchy.
- [Boiled singhara](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/boiled-singhara/): Fresh water chestnuts boiled in their shells, peeled and sprinkled with salt.
- [Kamal kakdi chips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/kamal-kakdi-chips/): Thinly sliced lotus stem, fried crisp with chilli and salt.
- [Arbi fry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/arbi-fry/): Boiled taro corms pan-fried with ajwain, chilli and amchur.
- [Suran cutlets](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/suran-cutlets/): Boiled elephant foot yam mashed with spices, shaped and pan-fried.
- [Singju](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/singju/): Manipuri salad of sliced tree bean, wild herbs and cabbage, dressed with roasted chilli and perilla.
- [Purslane salad](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/purslane-salad/): Tender purslane tips with onion, tomato, lime and roasted peanuts.
- [Kai chutney](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/kai-chutney/): Red ants and eggs ground with chilli, garlic, ginger and salt. Similipal's GI-tagged chutney.
- [Kaith chutney](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/kaith-chutney/): Wood apple pulp ground with jaggery, green chilli and roasted cumin.
- [Kachri chutney](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/kachri-chutney/): Dried kachri ground with garlic, red chilli and salt. Fiery Rajasthani chutney.
- [Thankuni bata / ondelaga chutney](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/thankuni-bata-ondelaga-chutney/): Pennywort ground with coconut, green chilli and a little tamarind.
- [Karibevu podi](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/karibevu-podi/): Dry-roasted curry leaves with urad dal, chilli and tamarind, ground to a powder for rice and dosa.
- [Amla pickle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/amla-pickle/): Steamed amla in mustard oil with fenugreek, mustard and chilli.
- [Karonda pickle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/karonda-pickle/): Halved karondas salted, then tossed in mustard oil with fennel and nigella.
- [Lasoda pickle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/lasoda-pickle/): Green lasoda berries pickled in mustard oil with fennel and turmeric.
- [Appe midi uppinakai](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/appe-midi-uppinakai/): Whole tender wild mangoes brined with mustard, chilli and turmeric. Malnad's prized pickle.
- [Ambade uppkari](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/ambade-uppkari/): Hog plums cooked with jaggery, chilli and mustard. A sweet-sour Konkani side.
- [Ou tenga chutney](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/ou-tenga-chutney/): Elephant apple layers boiled and mashed with mustard oil, chilli and salt.
- [Lingdu pickle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/lingdu-pickle/): Boiled fiddleheads in mustard oil with lemon, chilli and salt.
- [Timla pickle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/timla-pickle/): Unripe hill figs boiled, then pickled with mustard and chilli.
- [Akhrot chutney](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/akhrot-chutney/): Walnuts ground with curd, green chilli, mint and salt. A Kashmiri favourite.
- [Imli chutney](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/imli-chutney/): Tamarind cooked down with jaggery, dry ginger and roasted cumin.
- [Huli soppu chutney](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/huli-soppu-chutney/): Wood sorrel ground with coconut, chilli and a little jaggery. Small portions only.
- [Phogla raita](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/phogla-raita/): Soaked phog buds stirred into whisked curd with cumin and salt.
- [Bathua raita](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/bathua-raita/): Boiled, chopped bathua folded into curd with roasted cumin.
- [Ugadi pachadi](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/ugadi-pachadi/): Neem flowers, raw mango, tamarind, jaggery, salt and chilli: six tastes in one spoonful for the new year.
- [Shevgyachya shenganchi amti](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/shevgyachya-shenganchi-amti/): Maharashtrian drumstick amti: toor dal with goda masala, kokum or tamarind and a touch of jaggery.
- [Chinch-gulachi amti](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/chinch-gulachi-amti/): Sweet-sour tamarind and jaggery dal with goda masala. A Pune and Konkan staple.
- [Karvandachi chutney](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/karvandachi-chutney/): Raw karvanda ground with green chilli, jaggery and salt. A Maharashtrian monsoon side.
- [Nugge soppu palya](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/nugge-soppu-palya/): Moringa leaves stir-fried with mustard, urad dal, onion and grated coconut.
- [Drumstick sambar](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/drumstick-sambar/): Toor dal and tamarind sambar with drumstick pods simmered until tender.
- [Dantu soppu saaru](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/dantu-soppu-saaru/): Amaranth simmered with dal, tamarind and rasam powder, tempered with garlic.
- [Bathua saag](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/bathua-saag/): Bathua slow-cooked with mustard greens, garlic and makki atta, finished with ghee.
- [Basale bassaru](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/basale-bassaru/): Malabar spinach and dal stock as a spicy saaru, with the greens as palya. Two dishes from one pot.
- [Honagonne saaru](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/honagonne-saaru/): Sessile joyweed in a light dal saaru with garlic tempering.
- [Kandali saag](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/kandali-saag/): Blanched nettles cooked with garlic, chilli and a little rice flour. A Kumaoni winter dish.
- [Kalmi saag](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/kalmi-saag/): Water spinach stir-fried with nigella, garlic and dry chilli.
- [Takla bhaji / chakoda bhaji](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/takla-bhaji-chakoda-bhaji/): Tender senna leaves cooked dry with onion, garlic and besan.
- [Kartoli bhaji / kantola sabzi](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/kartoli-bhaji-kantola-sabzi/): Sliced spiny gourd stir-fried with onion and spices, or stuffed and fried.
- [Tondli bhaji](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/tondli-bhaji/): Ivy gourd slices cooked with peanuts, coconut and goda masala.
- [Ker sangri](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/ker-sangri/): Dried ker berries and sangri beans soaked, boiled and cooked with yoghurt, red chilli and amchur.
- [Panchkuta](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/panchkuta/): The Thar's five-ingredient desert curry, cooked dry with spices and oil.
- [Kachnar ki sabzi](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/kachnar-ki-sabzi/): Blanched kachnar buds cooked with onion, curd and garam masala.
- [Kathal biryani](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/kathal-biryani/): Raw jackfruit chunks layered with rice and whole spices. It eats like meat.
- [Kalale palya](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/kalale-palya/): Boiled bamboo shoots cooked dry with coconut and chilli. A Malnad monsoon dish.
- [Bamboo shoot pork](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/bamboo-shoot-pork/): Pork cooked with fermented bamboo shoot and chilli. A Naga and Assamese classic.
- [Bet gaaj bhaji](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/bet-gaaj-bhaji/): Bitter cane shoot core stir-fried with potato and mustard oil.
- [Lingdu bhaji](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/lingdu-bhaji/): Fiddleheads boiled, then stir-fried with garlic, cumin and chilli.
- [Nadru yakhni](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/nadru-yakhni/): Lotus stem in a fennel and dry-ginger yoghurt gravy. Kashmiri.
- [Chena erissery](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/chena-erissery/): Elephant foot yam with black-eyed beans in roasted coconut. A Kerala Onam dish.
- [Wild yam curry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/wild-yam-curry/): Soaked and boiled yam chunks in a coconut or mustard curry.
- [Eromba with yongchak](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/eromba-with-yongchak/): Manipuri mash of boiled tree bean, potato, fermented fish and fiery chilli.
- [Kudampuli fish curry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/kudampuli-fish-curry/): Kerala red fish curry soured with smoked Malabar tamarind.
- [Kokum saaru](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/kokum-saaru/): Thin, tangy kokum rasam tempered with ghee and cumin.
- [Ou tenga dal](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/ou-tenga-dal/): Masoor dal soured with elephant apple slices. Assamese summer comfort.
- [Puliyogare](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/puliyogare/): Rice tossed in a thick tamarind paste with sesame, peanuts and curry leaves.
- [Veppam poo rasam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/veppam-poo-rasam/): Fried neem flowers in a tamarind rasam. Bitter, sour and soothing.
- [Tisryo masala](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/tisryo-masala/): Clams on the half shell cooked dry with coconut and Goan spices.
- [Nandu rasam / kekda curry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/nandu-rasam-kekda-curry/): Paddy crabs in a peppery rasam or a thick coconut curry.
- [Gugli curry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/gugli-curry/): Boiled, cleaned snails in a spicy onion-garlic gravy. Odisha and Bengal.
- [Jambu tadka dal](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/jambu-tadka-dal/): Dal finished with jambu leaves sizzled in ghee. The Garhwali signature.
- [Shatavari stir-fry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/shatavari-stir-fry/): Wild asparagus spears tossed in mustard oil with garlic.
- [Atti kai palya](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/atti-kai-palya/): Unripe cluster figs boiled and cooked dry with coconut.
- [Mahua bhat](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/mahua-bhat/): Dried mahua flowers cooked into rice for natural sweetness. A tribal staple.
- [Bathua paratha](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/bathua-paratha/): Chopped bathua kneaded into wheat dough with ajwain, rolled and roasted with ghee.
- [Moringa thepla](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/moringa-thepla/): Soft flatbreads of wheat and besan with moringa leaves and spices.
- [Sogra](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/sogra/): Thick bajra rotis made with ground matira seeds. Desert winter fare.
- [Singhara atta puri](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/singhara-atta-puri/): Water chestnut flour puris, eaten on fasting days.
- [Wild greens dosa](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/wild-greens-dosa/): Ground rice and dal batter with a handful of greens. No fermentation needed.
- [Bhagar / nivara khichdi](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/bhagar-nivara-khichdi/): Wild rice or jungle rice cooked with peanuts, cumin, green chilli and ghee. The classic fasting meal.
- [Shapla khoi](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/shapla-khoi/): Water lily seeds popped in a hot pan like tiny popcorn, then salted.
- [Roasted siali seeds](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/roasted-siali-seeds/): Siali seeds roasted in their shells, then cracked and eaten warm. A tribal Odisha snack.
- [Wild mung dal](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/wild-mung-dal/): Small wild green gram cooked into a simple dal with garlic and cumin tempering.
- [Rice bean with pork](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/rice-bean-with-pork/): Naga-style rice bean slow-cooked with smoked pork and chilli.
- [Bhurat roti](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/bhurat-roti/): Ground bhurat seeds mixed into bajra flour and patted into thick rotis. Desert famine fare.
- [Bamboo rice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/bamboo-rice/): Cooked like ordinary rice, with a nutty, sticky bite.
- [Mahua laddoo](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/mahua-laddoo/): Dried mahua flowers roasted and pounded with roasted grains and sesame.
- [Tikhur barfi](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/tikhur-barfi/): Tikhur starch cooked with milk and sugar until it sets, then cut into squares. Chhattisgarh's festival sweet.
- [Bamboo rice payasam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/bamboo-rice-payasam/): Bamboo rice simmered in coconut milk and jaggery with cardamom.
- [Makhana kheer](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/makhana-kheer/): Roasted fox nuts simmered in milk with sugar, cardamom and chironji.
- [Aam papad](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/aam-papad/): Mango pulp and jaggery sun-dried in thin layers into fruit leather.
- [Amla murabba](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/amla-murabba/): Whole amla slow-cooked in sugar syrup with cardamom.
- [Chakka varatti](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/chakka-varatti/): Ripe jackfruit cooked down with jaggery and ghee into a dark jam. Kerala.
- [Jamun sorbet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/jamun-sorbet/): Jamun pulp blended with sugar, lime and black salt, then frozen.
- [Mulberry jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/mulberry-jam/): Mulberries cooked with sugar and lemon until thick.
- [Guava cheese](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/guava-cheese/): Guava pulp cooked with sugar and butter until it sets, then cut. A Goan Christmas sweet.
- [Himalayan berry jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/himalayan-berry-jam/): Wild hill berries cooked with sugar into jam.
- [Sitaphal basundi](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/sitaphal-basundi/): Custard apple pulp folded into reduced, sweetened milk.
- [Nolen gur sandesh](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/nolen-gur-sandesh/): Fresh chhena kneaded with date-palm jaggery. Bengal's winter sweet.
- [Chironji barfi](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/in/dishes/chironji-barfi/): Toasted chironji in a milk and sugar fudge.
